rows.ARS:
Pink blend Floribunda.
Registration name: BARsus
rows.Origin: Bred by Anna Medici Barni (Italy, before 1993).
rows.Bloom: Carmine-pink, white undertones, cream reverse. Moderate fragrance. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, compact, well-branched. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 16" to 2' (40 to 60cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Susanna ("Suni") Agnelli, former Foreign Minister of Italy, was born on April 24, 1922.
Participated in the 1993 Monza Competition. (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli.)
